data.content: APPROVED. The plan covers every acceptance criterion and keeps the change within existing Diffinite code, persistent Git storage, persona capability storage, and deployment rails. Security conditions for implementation: validate the entire receive batch before any per-ref decision; bind inbox ownership to server-supplied credential UUID; keep capability resolution fail-closed; never let a persona self-grant integrator; preserve foreign hook refusal; and prove core.hooksPath remains on v8 after running the actual v7 installer. Live freeze probes must use a bounded disposable repository/ref namespace until the Knots bridge has separately met cutover preconditions.
